dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't tell me there are Geo, Electro, Cryo, and Anemo Squishy-Hedgehogs too...
I don't know about that, but since there are so many different kinds, maybe the next time Mr. Cyclops goes adventuring, he'll run into a Geo-Lectro, Cry-O-Nemo Squishy-Hedgehog just like you said!
